title: Raster tile reveal (Springs aerial-map assemble)
source: springs.estate l-gallery (section-entry aerial map). Engine = library/components/raster-tile-reveal (proven, owns_pin:false, owns_scroll:false, pure set(p); a frozen mosaic of plain tiles, decode-guarded staggered reveal + real POI dots).
engine: A frozen mosaic of raster map tiles that force-decode up front, then fade + scale in tile-by-tile along a diagonal stagger; then real POI dots drop onto their spots. Pure set(p) scrub of the whole reveal: tiles finish by p~0.62, dots land by p=1 (reversible).
differs: Same tile-reveal mechanic + same pure set(p); BOTH platforms scroll-pin the reveal (scroll-scrub in a pin). Difference is LAYOUT (mobile full-bleed single-column sticky mosaic; desktop centred max-width mosaic) + pin-length, NOT scroll-vs-time. Springs mobile pins the section and scrubs the reveal by scroll (T-PIN-RUNSCENE), same as desktop.

desktop.driver: scrollReveal — set(p) = scroll progress across the pin span (mosaic pinned).

mobile.driver: scrollReveal — same set(p) = scroll progress across the pin span; mosaic sticks full-bleed single-column.

tiles.what: [{src,col,row}] — the mosaic tiles (real baked satellite tiles in production; one render sliced via object-position in the lab).

pois.what: [{x,y,label}] — real OSM POIs in % of the mosaic box; dots drop in the last 0.38 of the timeline.

stagger.what: per-tile diagonal (row+col) stagger of the reveal.

engine_patch: NONE. The engine has NO narrow-guard (no max-width matchMedia static-lock), so no forceMotion patch is needed. The wrapper passes auto:false so the engine's own ScrollTrigger one-shot does NOT fire and steal control — the wrapper owns the scroll-pin driver on both platforms and drives set(p). engine.js is a verbatim copy of library/components/raster-tile-reveal/component.js.
entry: RasterTileRevealDual.init(target, opts). Load engine.js THEN component.js. target = .rtr-stage (the .rtr-mosaic + tiles + dots are injected). Both platforms wrap in .pin-wrap for the pin; the wrapper adds .rtr-pinned to the stage.
law: transform (scale + translateY) + opacity + filter only; frozen mosaic (no pan/zoom engine); decode-guard before paint; GPU; NO width/height/top/left, NO mix-blend, NO backdrop, NO WebGL, NO canvas. reduced-motion → static (fully shown). Both platforms scroll-pin (MOBILE=PINNED-SCROLL law).
